name: Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy (Hubble)
blurb: The Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy (ESO 270-G017), a superthin edge-on galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso270017-hubble
story: Seen edge-on, the Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy is a remarkably thin disk that has been clearly disturbed; it lies on the sky southeast of the radio galaxy Centaurus A, and Hubble observed it to measure its distance from its red giant stars.

claims.text: The Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy is also known as ESO 270-G017
The Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy is a superthin edge-on galaxy
The Fourcade-Figueroa galaxy is clearly disturbed
It lies southeast of the core of the radio galaxy Centaurus A on the sky
ESO 270-G017 is also catalogued as HIPASS J1334-45
Hubble program 13442 observed ESO 270-017 to measure distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch
